result.summary: The food delivery home screen has several layout overflow issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, and the bottom tab bar is missing an Orders icon.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge, truncating the name 'Trattoria Piccol' and hiding part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel peeks enough of the next card without clipping text, or add padding so names fully wrap/ellipsis inside the visible card.

issues.description: The bottom navigation 'Orders' tab has no icon, only the label, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the matching Orders icon (e.g. receipt/bag) and align it with the other tab items.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the right edge so 'Healthy' is only partially visible and the next chip is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling with a fade/peek, or wrap/resize chips so all labels stay fully readable.

issues.description: The second Popular restaurant card is clipped at the bottom of the viewport, cutting off the pizza image and any title/details below it.
issues.suggestion: Allow the list to scroll fully so cards aren’t cropped by the tab bar, or add bottom padding so the last visible card isn’t cut mid-image.
